explanation: Push openers onto a stack and compare each closer with the top. Reject a mismatch or an empty stack at a closer.
correctness: The stack records exactly the unmatched openers in nesting order. A closer can legally match only the top, so each accepted match preserves the invariant.
walkthrough: Scanning a{b[c](d)}, ignore letters and push {, then [. The ] removes [, the ( is pushed and removed by ), and the final } removes {. No closer crosses another pair and the stack finishes empty, so return true.
